component-o.description-s: 2.2 uH ±20% shielded composite power inductor, IHLP-5050FD-01, 13.2 x 12.9 x 6.4 mm max, DCR 4.2 mOhm max / 3.5 typ, Isat 40 A typ (-20 % L), heat rating 22 A typ (40 C rise)

source-o.table-s: STANDARD ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS row 2.2 uH: DCR typ 3.5 / max 4.2 mOhm (25 C), heat rating current 22 A DC typ (note 1: approx. 40 C rise), saturation current 40 A DC typ (note 2: L0 drops approx. 20 %); DIMENSIONS: 0.520 +/- 0.02 in [13.2 +/- 0.5 mm], 0.508 in [12.9 mm] max, height 0.252 in [6.4 mm] max; rated operating voltage 75 V; frequency range up to 5.0 MHz

specs-o.isat_basis-s: Vishay states saturation current as typical only (40 A DC typ, L0 down about 20 %, p1); isat_ma_i carries that typical figure, 2.3x the TPS61288 17.1 A max current limit

component-o.esr_note-s: esr-mr-i is the integer of the 4.2 mOhm max DCR
